description: Burj Clean Energy Modaraba (BCEM) describes itself as Pakistan's first Shariah-compliant green energy fund and holds the country's first Green Energy Fund licence, structured as a multi-purpose, perpetual fund with paid-up capital of PKR 1 billion. It is managed by Burj Investment Management Limited, a subsidiary of Burj Energy International Management Limited, and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange's GEM board. It develops and owns clean energy projects under long-term contracts, with 57 MW operational across the PCL Solar and Jhimpir Wind projects at the time of writing.
